townRating.rationale: One star remains accurate: Strathyre has unusually good village-start walking and cycling, one top food stop and characterful outdoor art, but limited indoor depth and little reason for a broad all-weather visit.

boundary.previous: Supplied rectangular study extent from longitude -4.336 to -4.3085 and latitude 56.3186 to 56.3368.
boundary.active: Five OpenStreetMap residential landuse polygons with 90-metre envelopes and a narrow 120-metre visitor corridor between Broch Field, the village centre, forest car park and Village Hall.
boundary.nrsFinding: Strathyre is not present as a named locality in the NRS 2022 locality shapefile.
boundary.rule: Every town-planner marker is inside the active visitor boundary. Trail routes may leave it, but their published start point must remain inside Strathyre.

excluded.name: The White Stag Inn and The Munro Inn
excluded.reason: Current sources indicate closure; neither is published as an Eat recommendation.

excluded.name: Ben Sheann Hotel restaurant
excluded.reason: The current hotel website does not provide sufficiently clear public restaurant information for a defensible curated Eat listing.

excluded.name: Strathyre Village Hall parking
excluded.reason: The council describes only three or four limited spaces; these are not promoted as general visitor parking.

excluded.name: Loch Lubnaig, Balquhidder and Kingshouse places
excluded.reason: Outside the active Strathyre town boundary and not counted towards its rating.

artwork.treatment: Text-free original light ink-and-watercolour illustration in the established Townscape Guides style.
